units: Gen. R. s. 1, beg. דְּרוֹמוֹ של רקיע the southern section of the sky; a. fr.—Esp. הַדָּ׳ (b. h. הַנֶּגֶב) the South of Palestine, south of Lydda (with a town of the same name: Darom, v. Neub. Géogr. p. 63).

<cite ref="Yevamot 45a:5">Yeb. 45ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Zevachim 22b:14">Zeb. 22ᵇ</cite> <he>זקני ד׳</he>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Eruvin 6:4:5">Y. Erub. VI, 23ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>זקני הד׳</he> the scholars of D.
